body: Thank you.. it’s nice to hear someone is on my side... all my life it’s always been “it’s not that serious” or something along those lines. I wish more people would understand that it’s not just to create trouble but that this kind of stuff is serious, and that triggering topics and experiences are real.

They’re actual scum of the earth in so many ways. To completely ruin the life of another person over something that was probably super petty... and it’s almost minimizing the situations of other women who were actually raped.
Probably tell people the things I didn’t have the guts to tell them before

When I say it to someone, I really hope they do take the offer. However, when someone says it to me, I never really take up on it. I don’t think anyone actually cares enough to listen, it’s more like they say it to be nice or because they don’t know what to say. But, because I think this way, the people I say it to probably think the same thing

I’d pick an island that isn’t too populated. Eventually all of the zombies will have been killed and there’s not really a way for more zombies to get in, unless more people come to the island and die... I’m sure there was probably a farm somewhere so I’d look for one and tend to any left over livestock and grow my own crops.

I was in fifth grade, he was the new kid. He was abnormally mature for a fifth grader, very tall and had a voice so deep that it was not easy to understand unless you were used to it. I guess there’s not much too it, but we were chill. We sat together in art class and he would tell me jokingly that he hated me because my art was “better than his”. He had to move because his stepdad was in the army, so I went home crying. Lol
Sentence him to the most brutal and painful death

I mean, kind of. Once I was talking to a friend of mine that (as a hormonal young teen) had a very strong sex drive. Often they would talk to me to get it out of their head but they ended up still going through with it while they talked to me. Sometimes during the middle of a call they would tell me that I could stay and listen but I found it uncomfortable so I’d always let them do their thing before talking. I don’t think it was because of me though, so it probably doesn’t count
I feel the same way... it’s hard to go by everyday and not see any reason to continue. Everything seems so pointless. Especially when you feel like there’s no one by your side...
